main.description: A post in a thread: a chat message, a forum reply or a comment on an article alike. Written by its author. A channel's untitled chat is the posts whose thread is the channel's own document.

thread.description: The site.standard.document this post belongs to: a thread, a channel, or any article.

replyTo.description: The post this one answers, if any. Apps may show replies flat (forum, chat) or nested (comments).

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the post. Required, unlike in site.standard.document, so every reader can show every post. Should not contain markdown or other formatting.

content.description: The post in an app-native format. Open union, as in site.standard.document.

labels.description: Self-label values for this post. Effectively content warnings.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the post's last edit.
